title: generate assistant message id from backend side

linked_prs.title: feat (ui): generate and forward message ids for response messages
linked_prs.body:
## Background

`useChat` currently generates IDs for each new message that is received from the server. Since the messages might already be stored on the server (through onFinish), the server ids might not match those client ids. To ensure that there are no differences, we need to introduce a systematic message ID generation mechanism in `streamText` and `generateText`, and then forward the message IDs from the server to the client.

Fixes #3061

## Tasks

- [x] implementation
   - [x] stream parts & useChat
      - [x] introduce start step data stream part
      - [x] extract id from start step stream part (when available; needs to be backwards compatible)
   - [x] extract ResponseMessage type
   - [x] appendResponseMessages needs to use existing ids
   - [x] expose id generator factory
   - [x] streamText
      - [x] configurable ID generator for message ids
      - [x] add ids to response message for each step (stable)
      - [x] start step text parts
      - [x] send ids in start step stream part
      - [x] edge case: continuation (needs to keep same id)
   - [x] generateText
      - [x]  configurable ID generator for message ids
      - [x] add ids to response message for each step (stable)
      - [x] edge case: continuation (needs to keep same id)
- [x] examples
   - [x] update next.js use chat persistence example
- [x] documentation
   - [x] start step data stream part
   - [x] append response messages
   - [x] persistence guide: add section
   - [x] streamText reference
      - [x] message id generator
      - [x] updated stream parts
      - [x] changed step result
   - [x] generateText reference
      - [x] message id generator
      - [x] changed step result
- [x] changeset

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This is an agent issue because it concerns memory content errors and memory initialization issues: the backend must persist and consistently assign message IDs for AI-generated messages to maintain chat history integrity, which is a core agent memory mechanism. The issue directly affects agent message storage and retrieval.
